library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
da <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "exp1b")
da$Nlevel <- as.numeric(da$Nlevel)

# ======================
# Split by N history
# ======================
data1 <- da[da$Nhistory == "Ncont", ]
data2 <- da[da$Nhistory == "Ncess", ]

# ======================
# Shared mappings
# ======================
da$Nregime  <- factor(da$Nhistory, levels = c("Ncont", "Ncess"))
da$Nhistory <- factor(da$Nhistory, levels = c("Ncont", "Ncess"))

color_history <- c("Ncont" = "darkred", "Ncess" = "darkblue")
lines <- c("Ncont" = "solid",   "Ncess" = "solid")
shap  <- c("Ncont" = 19,        "Ncess" = 19)

# ======================
# Helper: build a two-line label (rho and P) as plotmath strings
#   - rho: always 3 decimals
#   - P  : scientific notation (1 decimal) if p < 0.001,
#          otherwise fixed decimal (3 decimals)
# ======================
make_lab <- function(ct) {
  rho <- round(unname(ct$estimate), 3)
  p   <- ct$p.value
  
  p_str <- if (p < 0.001) {
    sprintf("%.1e", p)      # e.g. "4.7e-09"
  } else {
    sprintf("%.3f", p)      # e.g. "0.023"
  }
  
  list(
    rho = sprintf("atop(italic(rho)==%.3f)", rho),
    p   = sprintf("atop(italic(P)==%s)",     p_str)
  )
}

# Load packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
## 
## Attaching package: 'dplyr'
## The following objects are masked from 'package:stats':
## 
##     filter, lag
## The following objects are masked from 'package:base':
## 
##     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
library(ggsignif)
library(readxl)
# Read data
df <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "exp2a")

# Ensure treatment is a factor
df$treatment <- factor(df$treatment, levels = c("Non-acidified", "Acidified"))
df$treatment <- factor(df$treatment, labels = c("Control", "Acid added"))

# Welch's t-test (unequal variances, heteroscedastic t-test)
t_result <- t.test(ROS ~ treatment,
                   data        = df,
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   var.equal   = FALSE)   # FALSE = Welch's t-test
p_val    <- t_result$p.value
t_val    <- t_result$statistic

# ===== Format p-value =====
fmt_p <- ifelse(p_val < 0.0001,
                sprintf("%.2e", p_val),
                sprintf("%.3f", p_val))

# ===== Statistic label: t first, p second, comma-separated, one line =====
stat_label <- sprintf("t = %.2f, p = %s", t_val, fmt_p)

# Colors
group_colors <- c("Control" = "#B07AA1", "Acid added" = "#6BAED6")

# y position for the bracket
y_max   <- max(df$ROS, na.rm = TRUE)
y_range <- diff(range(df$ROS, na.rm = TRUE))
y_pos   <- y_max + y_range * 0.15

# Plot
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = treatment, y = ROS, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = treatment),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.15),
    size = 5.2, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  
  # ★ Show t and p above the bracket, instead of stars
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("Control", "Acid added")),
    y_position  = y_pos,
    annotation  = stat_label,   # ← "t = ..., p = ..."
    textsize    = 5.5,
    size        = 1.2,
    tip_length  = 0.02,
    vjust       = -0.6          # ← negative vjust moves label above the line
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.28))) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Reactive oxygen species (ROS)",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Relative abundance of ROS-related genes (\u00D7/Gb)"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # ===== Global default: black bold =====
    text = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    
    # ===== Main title =====
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16,
                              face = "bold", colour = "black",
                              margin = margin(t = 5, b = 8)),
    
    # ===== Hide legend =====
    legend.position = "none",
    
    # ===== Axis text =====
    axis.text.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold",
                                angle = 90),
    axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    
    # ===== Ticks / border =====
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid"),
    
    # ===== Margins =====
    plot.margin  = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

print(p)

ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Fig3c.pdf",

# Load required packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ===== Set working directory =====
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# ===== Read data =====
df <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "exp2a")

# Ensure treatment is a factor and set labels
df$treatment <- factor(df$treatment, levels = c("Non-acidified", "Acidified"))
df$treatment <- factor(df$treatment, labels = c("Control", "Acid added"))

# ===== Colors =====
group_colors <- c("Control" = "#B07AA1", "Acid added" = "#6BAED6")

# ===== Variables and labels =====
xvar <- "ROS"
yvar <- "ARG"
xlab_text <- "Relative abundance of ROS-related genes (\u00D7/Gb)"
ylab_text <- "Relative abundance of ARGs (\u00D7/Gb)"

# ===== Overall correlation (Spearman) =====
cor_res <- cor.test(df[[xvar]], df[[yvar]], method = "spearman")
rho_val <- round(unname(cor_res$estimate), 3)
p_raw   <- cor_res$p.value

# Format p-value: scientific (1 decimal) if < 0.001, otherwise 3 decimals
fmt_p <- if (p_raw < 0.001) {
  sprintf("%.1e", p_raw)
} else {
  sprintf("%.3f", p_raw)
}

# Build plotmath label for ggplot
cor_label <- sprintf("atop(italic(rho) == %.3f, italic(P) == %s)", rho_val, fmt_p)

# ===== Position for the annotation (top-left corner) =====
x_min <- min(df[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(df[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
y_min <- min(df[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
y_max <- max(df[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)

anno_x <- x_min + 0.05 * (x_max - x_min)
anno_y <- y_max - 0.05 * (y_max - y_min)

# ===== Plot =====
p <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], colour = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 10) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = 'lm',
    formula = y ~ poly(x, 1, raw = TRUE),
    level = 0.95,
    se = TRUE,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.5,
    color = "black",
    fill = "grey70"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_colors, labels = c("Control", "Acid added")) +
  annotate("text", x = anno_x, y = anno_y,
           label = cor_label, parse = TRUE,
           size = 8, fontface = "bold", colour = "black", hjust = 0) +
  labs(
    x = xlab_text,
    y = ylab_text,
    colour = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16, family = "sans", colour = "black"),
    axis.text  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

# ===== Save figure =====
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
print(p)

ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Fig3d.pdf",
       p, width = 8, height = 6.5, dpi = 600)

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(agricolae)
library(car)
## Loading required package: carData
## 
## Attaching package: 'car'
## The following object is masked from 'package:dplyr':
## 
##     recode
library(rstatix)
## 
## Attaching package: 'rstatix'
## The following object is masked from 'package:stats':
## 
##     filter
library(dunn.test)

# ===== Read data =====
da <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "exp2b")
da$treatment2 <- factor(da$treatment2,
                        levels = c("N0-L0", "N20-L0", "N0-L45", "N20-L45"))

# ===== Parse N and L from treatment2 =====
da$N <- factor(sub("-.*", "", as.character(da$treatment2)), levels = c("N0", "N20"))
da$L <- factor(sub(".*-", "", as.character(da$treatment2)), levels = c("L0", "L45"))

# ===== Variable and y-axis title =====
yvar      <- "ROS"
ylab_ros  <- "Relative abundance of ROS-related genes (\u00D7/Gb)"
title_ros <- "Reactive oxygen species (ROS)"

col11 <- c("#D7191C", "#FDAE61", "#2C7BB6", "#1A9641")

# ===== X-axis labels: Control, N, L, N+L =====
trt_labs <- c(
  "N0-L0"   = "Control",
  "N20-L0"  = "N",
  "N0-L45"  = "L",
  "N20-L45" = "N+L"
)

# ===== Two-way ANOVA text annotation: single line =====
anova_lab <- function(y, N, L) {
  fit <- aov(y ~ N * L)
  s   <- summary(fit)[[1]]
  fmt <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA",
                            ifelse(x < 0.001,
                                   format(x, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3),
                                   sprintf("%.3f", x)))
  paste0(
    "N: F=",   fmt(s[1, "F value"]), ", P=", fmt(s[1, "Pr(>F)"]), "   ",
    "L: F=",   fmt(s[2, "F value"]), ", P=", fmt(s[2, "Pr(>F)"]), "   ",
    "N\u00D7L: F=", fmt(s[3, "F value"]), ", P=", fmt(s[3, "Pr(>F)"])
  )
}

# ===== Assumption tests =====
cat("===== Shapiro-Wilk normality test (by group) =====\n")
## ===== Shapiro-Wilk normality test (by group) =====
shapiro_res <- da %>%
  group_by(treatment2) %>%
  summarise(
    W = shapiro.test(.data[[yvar]])$statistic,
    p = shapiro.test(.data[[yvar]])$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(shapiro_res)
## # A tibble: 4 × 3
##   treatment2     W      p
##   <fct>      <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1 N0-L0      0.793 0.0705
## 2 N20-L0     0.781 0.0565
## 3 N0-L45     0.961 0.814 
## 4 N20-L45    0.998 0.998
cat("\n===== Levene's test for homogeneity of variance =====\n")
## 
## ===== Levene's test for homogeneity of variance =====
lev <- leveneTest(as.formula(paste(yvar, "~ treatment2")), data = da)
print(lev)
## Levene's Test for Homogeneity of Variance (center = median)
##       Df F value Pr(>F)
## group  3  1.0096 0.4142
##       16
normal_ok <- all(shapiro_res$p > 0.05)
var_ok    <- lev$`Pr(>F)`[1] > 0.05

cat("\nNormality satisfied: ", normal_ok, "\n")
## 
## Normality satisfied:  TRUE
cat("Homogeneity of variance satisfied: ", var_ok, "\n")
## Homogeneity of variance satisfied:  TRUE
if (normal_ok && var_ok) {
  method <- "Tukey HSD"
} else if (normal_ok && !var_ok) {
  method <- "Games-Howell"
} else {
  method <- "Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn"
}
cat("\nMethod selected: ", method, "\n")
## 
## Method selected:  Tukey HSD
# ===== CLD function =====
cld_from_pairs <- function(groups, pairs, p_col = "p.adj", alpha = 0.05) {
  groups <- as.character(groups)
  n <- length(groups)
  diff_mat <- matrix(FALSE, n, n, dimnames = list(groups, groups))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {
    g1 <- as.character(pairs[[1]][i])
    g2 <- as.character(pairs[[2]][i])
    p  <- pairs[[p_col]][i]
    if (!is.na(p) && p < alpha) {
      diff_mat[g1, g2] <- TRUE
      diff_mat[g2, g1] <- TRUE
    }
  }
  letters_pool <- letters
  assign <- rep(NA_character_, n)
  names(assign) <- groups
  current_letter <- 1
  remaining <- groups
  while (length(remaining) > 0) {
    grp_set <- remaining[1]
    for (g in remaining[-1]) {
      ok <- TRUE
      for (h in grp_set) {
        if (diff_mat[g, h]) { ok <- FALSE; break }
      }
      if (ok) grp_set <- c(grp_set, g)
    }
    for (g in grp_set) {
      assign[g] <- ifelse(is.na(assign[g]),
                          letters_pool[current_letter],
                          paste0(assign[g], letters_pool[current_letter]))
    }
    remaining <- setdiff(remaining, grp_set)
    current_letter <- current_letter + 1
  }
  data.frame(grp = groups, sig_lab = assign, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# ===== Generate compact letter display by method =====
df2 <- data.frame(y = da[[yvar]], trt = da$treatment2)

if (method == "Tukey HSD") {
  fit <- aov(y ~ trt, data = df2)
  hsd <- agricolae::HSD.test(fit, "trt", group = TRUE)
  g   <- hsd$groups
  lab <- data.frame(grp = rownames(g),
                    sig_lab = as.character(g$groups),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else if (method == "Games-Howell") {
  gh  <- rstatix::games_howell_test(df2, y ~ trt)
  lab <- cld_from_pairs(unique(df2$trt), gh, p_col = "p.adj")
} else {
  dt  <- rstatix::dunn_test(df2, y ~ trt, p.adjust.method = "BH")
  lab <- cld_from_pairs(unique(df2$trt), dt, p_col = "p.adj")
}

# ===== Y-axis range =====
ymin <- min(da[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
ymax <- max(da[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
yran <- ymax - ymin

# Position of significance letters
mx <- da %>%
  group_by(treatment2) %>%
  summarise(max_y = max(.data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE) + 0.08 * yran,
            .groups = "drop")
lab <- left_join(lab, mx, by = c("grp" = "treatment2"))

# ===== Compute ANOVA text =====
anova_txt <- anova_lab(da[[yvar]], da$N, da$L)

# ===== Plot =====
p <- ggplot(da, aes(x = treatment2, y = .data[[yvar]])) +
  # ===== KEY CHANGE: use position_jitterdodge, smaller size, add stroke =====
geom_jitter(aes(fill = treatment2, color = treatment2),
            shape = 21, stroke = 0.4,
            position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15,
                                            dodge.width  = 0.5),
            size = 3.2, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = treatment2),
               width = 0.5, alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4,
               position = position_dodge(0.5), outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = trt_labs) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col11, labels = trt_labs) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col11, labels = trt_labs) +
  geom_text(data = lab, aes(x = grp, y = max_y, label = sig_lab),
            size = 6, fontface = "bold", colour = "black",
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title    = title_ros,
    subtitle = anova_txt,
    fill     = "Treatment",
    color    = "Treatment",
    x        = "",
    y        = ylab_ros
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # ===== Global default text: black and bold =====
    text = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    
    # ===== Main title: larger, black, bold, centered =====
    plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16,
                                 face = "bold", colour = "black",
                                 margin = margin(t = 5, b = 2)),
    
    # ===== Subtitle (statistical results): centered at top outside panel =====
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10,
                                 face = "bold", colour = "black",
                                 lineheight = 1.0,
                                 margin = margin(t = 0, b = 8)),
    
    # ===== Hide legend =====
    legend.position = "none",
    
    # ===== Axis text: black, bold =====
    axis.text.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    
    # ===== Axis lines / tick marks: black =====
    axis.line    = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid"),
    
    # ===== Plot margin =====
    plot.margin  = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(ymin - 0.05 * yran, ymax + 0.30 * yran),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  )
print(p)

ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Fig3e.pdf",
       p, width = 6, height = 5.5, dpi = 600)

# Load required packages
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(car)

# ===== Set working directory =====
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# ===== Read data =====
da <-  read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "exp2b")
da$treatment2 <- factor(da$treatment2,
                        levels = c("N0-L0", "N20-L0", "N0-L45", "N20-L45"))

# ===== Set colors and legend labels =====
col11 <- c("#D7191C", "#FDAE61", "#2C7BB6", "#1A9641")
trt_labs <- c(
  "N0-L0"   = "Control",
  "N20-L0"  = "N",
  "N0-L45"  = "L",
  "N20-L45" = "N+L"
)

# ===== Set variables and labels =====
xvar <- "ROS"
yvar <- "ARG5_CARD"
xlab_text <- "Relative abundance of ROS-related genes (\u00D7/Gb)"
ylab_text <- "Relative abundance of ARGs (\u00D7/Gb)"

# ===== Compute overall correlation (not grouped) =====
# Spearman's rank correlation (does not assume normality)
cor_res <- cor.test(da[[xvar]], da[[yvar]],
                    method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
rho_val <- round(cor_res$estimate, 3)
p_val   <- format(cor_res$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)

# Build the math expression label for ggplot
# Note: Spearman's coefficient is rho (\u03C1), not R
cor_label <- paste0("atop(italic(rho) == ", rho_val,
                    ", italic(P) == ", p_val, ")")

# ===== Compute annotation position (upper-left corner to avoid covering data) =====
x_min <- min(da[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(da[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
y_min <- min(da[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
y_max <- max(da[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)

# Annotation position (upper-left corner; adjust x, y if needed)
anno_x <- x_min + 0.05 * (x_max - x_min)
anno_y <- y_max - 0.05 * (y_max - y_min)

# ===== Plot =====
p <- ggplot(data = da, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], colour = treatment2)) +
  # Scatter plot: size = 10, alpha = 0.5 (as in the first code)
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 10) +
  # Overall fitted line: not grouped, uniform black color
  geom_smooth(
    method  = 'lm',
    formula = y ~ poly(x, 1, raw = TRUE),
    level   = 0.95,
    se      = TRUE,
    size    = 2,
    alpha   = 0.5,
    color   = "black",   # Uniform line color
    fill    = "grey70"   # Confidence interval fill color
  ) +
  # Color mapping
  scale_colour_manual(values = col11, labels = trt_labs) +
  # Add correlation annotation
  annotate("text", x = anno_x, y = anno_y,
           label = cor_label, parse = TRUE,
           size = 8, fontface = "bold", colour = "black", hjust = 0) +
  labs(
    x = xlab_text,
    y = ylab_text,
    colour = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # Global text
    text = element_text(size = 16, family = "sans", colour = "black"),
    # Axis text: size = 16, bold
    axis.text  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    # Legend text: size = 16, bold
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    # Legend position
    legend.position = "right",
    # Panel border
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"),
    # Remove grid lines
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p)

# Figure size: width = 8, height = 6.5
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Fig3f.pdf",
       p, width = 8, height = 6.5, dpi = 600)

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(agricolae)
library(car)

da <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig3_data.xlsx", sheet = "exp2c")
da$treatment2 <- factor(da$treatment2,
                        levels = c("N0-C0", "N50-C0", "N0-C2000", "N50-C2000"))

da$N <- factor(sub("-.*", "", as.character(da$treatment2)), levels = c("N0", "N50"))
da$C <- factor(sub(".*-", "", as.character(da$treatment2)), levels = c("C0", "C2000"))

yvar      <- "ROS"
ylab_ros  <- "Relative abundance of ROS-related genes (\u00D7/Gb)"
title_ros <- "Reactive oxygen species (ROS)"

col11 <- c("#E89A9A", "#B8E986", "#F5C87A", "#8FD3F4")

trt_labs <- c(
  "N0-C0"     = "Control",
  "N50-C0"    = "N",
  "N0-C2000"  = "C",
  "N50-C2000" = "N+C"
)

anova_lab <- function(y, N, C) {
  df_tmp <- data.frame(y = y, N = N, C = C)
  fit <- aov(y ~ N * C, data = df_tmp)
  anova3 <- Anova(fit, type = "III")
  s   <- as.data.frame(anova3)
  
  fmt <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA",
                            ifelse(x < 0.001,
                                   format(x, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3),
                                   sprintf("%.3f", x)))
  paste0(
    "N: F=",   fmt(s["N", "F value"]), ", P=", fmt(s["N", "Pr(>F)"]), "   ",
    "C: F=",   fmt(s["C", "F value"]), ", P=", fmt(s["C", "Pr(>F)"]), "   ",
    "N\u00D7C: F=", fmt(s["N:C", "F value"]), ", P=", fmt(s["N:C", "Pr(>F)"])
  )
}

df2 <- data.frame(y = da[[yvar]], trt = da$treatment2)
fit_trt <- aov(y ~ trt, data = df2)
hsd <- agricolae::HSD.test(fit_trt, "trt", group = TRUE, console = FALSE)
lab <- data.frame(
  grp = rownames(hsd$groups),
  sig_lab = as.character(hsd$groups$groups),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

ymin <- min(da[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
ymax <- max(da[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
yran <- ymax - ymin

mx <- da %>%
  group_by(treatment2) %>%
  summarise(max_y = max(.data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE) + 0.08 * yran,
            .groups = "drop")

lab <- left_join(lab, mx, by = c("grp" = "treatment2"))

anova_txt <- anova_lab(da[[yvar]], da$N, da$C)

p <- ggplot(da, aes(x = treatment2, y = .data[[yvar]])) +
  geom_jitter(aes(fill = treatment2, color = treatment2),
              position = position_dodge(0.5),
              size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = treatment2),
               width = 0.5, alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4,
               position = position_dodge(0.5), outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = trt_labs) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col11, labels = trt_labs) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col11, labels = trt_labs) +
  geom_text(data = lab, aes(x = grp, y = max_y, label = sig_lab),
            size = 6, fontface = "bold", colour = "black",
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title    = title_ros,
    subtitle = anova_txt,
    fill     = "Treatment",
    color    = "Treatment",
    x        = "",
    y        = ylab_ros
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16,
                                 face = "bold", colour = "black",
                                 margin = margin(t = 5, b = 2)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10,
                                 face = "bold", colour = "black",
                                 lineheight = 1.0,
                                 margin = margin(t = 0, b = 8)),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.line    = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid"),
    plot.margin  = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(ymin - 0.05 * yran, ymax + 0.30 * yran),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  )

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
print(p)

ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Fig3g.pdf", p, width = 6, height = 5.5, dpi = 600)
